## Controlled repro: NOT REPRODUCED — the premise is falsified

Ran the protocol this card asked for (real Chromium via the repo's Playwright, no automation-harness clicking, viewport 800x900, **no resize of any kind** until the last step). Backend: showcase on `:3911`. Two independent cold loads on the target page, one on the control dashboard, one on the **published** console build, plus a first-draw profile and a zoom sweep.

### Reading 1 & 2 — target page, `page/showcase_command_center`, two independent cold loads

Both loads produced byte-identical censuses. Per chart svg, `rect` / `path` / `text` / `.recharts-bar-rectangle` / `.recharts-pie-sector` / `.recharts-area-area`, plus first `path` `d` length:

| t | 任务状态分布 | 项目健康度 | chart2 | trend (632px) | chart4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 s | r1 p5 t6 **bars=5** d=213 | r1 p3 t0 **sectors=3** d=144 | r1 p4 t7 bars=4 | r1 p2 t12 areas=1 | r1 p6 t7 bars=6 |
| 15 s | identical | identical | identical | identical | identical |
| 30 s | identical | identical | identical | identical | identical |

`POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query`: 10x 200, 0 failures. Screenshots at 5 s / 15 s / 30 s all show **full bars and a full donut**. Dispatching `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'))` after 30 s changed **nothing** (every count identical). A real 1px viewport change (800 to 801) changed only geometry (`d` lengths shift, box 290 to 291) — mark counts unchanged.

### Reading 3 — control page, `dashboard/showcase_ops_dashboard`

Same protocol, same outcome: bars=3 / bars=5 / sectors=4 / lines=1 all present at 5 s, unchanged at 15 s and 30 s, unchanged by the resize event. The target-vs-control asymmetry the card is built on does not exist.

### Reading 4 — the PUBLISHED console build (`:3911/_console`), the artifact the dogfood actually drove

Identical to the dev build: bars=5, sectors=3, areas=1 at 5 s, unchanged through 30 s with no resize.

### What the original census actually shows

The reported signature — status chart `1 rect, 5 paths`, health chart `3 paths and no text` — is **exactly the signature of a fully drawn chart** in this codebase, not of an axis-only frame. Dumped element by element:

- the status chart's 5 `path`s are all `class="recharts-rectangle"`, parent `recharts-layer recharts-inactive-bar`, each **37x252 px**, gradient-filled. Bars are drawn as `path` here, not `rect`.
- the health chart's 3 `path`s are all `class="recharts-sector"` — the three donut segments. A donut has no axes, hence no `text`; `no text` is its normal state, not a symptom.
- the lone `rect` in each is the unclassed chart background.

So step 2 of the original report was measuring a chart that had already drawn.

### The real blank window — finite, self-resolving, ~1 s wide

A finer profile (same cold load, no resize) locates the transient the 5 s screenshot most likely caught:

```
t=500..2500ms  surfaces=0   (charts not mounted yet)
t=3000ms       surfaces=5   r=1 p=0 t=6 bars=5 sec=2 area=1   <-- axis text, ZERO paths
t=4000ms       surfaces=5   r=1 p=5 t=6 bars=5 sec=3 area=1   <-- marks present
t=5000ms+      unchanged thereafter
```

`t=3000ms` is the genuine axis-only signature: `p=0`. It lasts about one second and clears **on its own**, with no resize. Under the dogfood's load (automation harness plus a full framework dev server) that window plausibly stretched past a 5 s screenshot — which explains observation 1 — while observation 2 at 10 s was already a drawn chart, and observation 3's zoom reset simply happened after the animation had finished. The "resize fixed it" causality is post hoc.

### Zoom hypothesis — also negative

Because the original reset zoom with cmd+0, I re-ran cold loads at zoom 0.5 / 0.67 / 0.8. All three: bars=5, sectors=3, areas=1 at 5 s, unchanged at 15 s. Zoom does not produce a stuck blank.

### Same code as the dogfood observed

The dogfood commit `67dadd602a3a` is an ancestor of the measured HEAD `b6e83be6a`. The only commit touching `packages/plugin-charts`, `packages/plugin-dashboard` or the page renderer in that range is `4ca30d044` (#7355), whose diff is `ObjectDataTable.tsx` plus its test — a table, not a chart. `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` is untouched in that range. So this is not a "already fixed since" result: the chart render path measured here is the same code the dogfood saw.

### Verdict

No fix, no PR. Nothing in the page chart block re-measures only on window resize; the marks arrive on their own and stay. Recommend closing as not-reproducible. `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` was not touched (#7385 / #7248 keep it).

If a slow-first-paint chart is worth pursuing as its own concern, it is a different card — an enter-animation window with no skeleton, visible as an axis-only frame for about a second — and it is cosmetic, not a stuck state.

PM disposition — reviewer of record: PM session `session_62849a16-0144-4728-8942-9f60bb3a73f1`.

Measurement-first outcome (b): two independent cold loads at 800×900 with no resize show every chart on the Command Center page fully drawn by t=5 s and byte-identical at 15 s and 30 s (dev build and the published console at :3911 alike); a dispatched resize changes nothing; the control dashboard behaves identically. The card's own census was misread by the reporter: bars render as `path.recharts-rectangle` and donut segments as `path.recharts-sector`, so "1 rect / 5 paths" IS a drawn bar chart, and a donut has no axis text by construction. The only transient is a ~1 s axis-only enter-animation window around t≈3 s, which the harness-loaded 5 s screenshot caught. The dogfood pin 67dadd602a3a is an ancestor of the measured head and nothing touched the chart packages in between, so this is a falsified premise, not fixed-since.

Closing as not-reproduced; no PR. Lesson recorded on the PM side: timing/first-paint readings taken inside the Claude Code browser pane are not filing-grade evidence — measure in a clean Playwright context first (same failure as #7249).
